name: lantern-night-3d
description: Lantern Night in 3D: a browser game about DBT skills

scripts.build: npm run ink && npm run bundle && npm run look
scripts.look: mkdir -p public/look && cp demo-src/index.html demo-src/styles.css public/look/ && esbuild demo-src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=public/look/main.js
